Add-to-cart could NOT be completed successfully in this session despite filling every discoverable required field across two different template configurations (template-277843 with 1 cat, template-578330 with 2 cats). HTTP 429 interstitial) was triggered multiple times during this session by repeated automated page.request calls to /cart.js and /cart/clear.js; unrelated to the teeinblue app itself, but it means some cart-state verification calls near the end of the session could not be confirmed with a clean 200 response.

On an earlier pass using waitUntil=domcontentloaded only (no extra wait), the same DOM query returned an EMPTY personalize-control list and 0 shadow-DOM/iframe hits for 'personalize' text — this was a false negative caused by reading the DOM before the SDK's JS finished rendering, not a real absence of the widget. observations.action: Read default variant + personalize state before any interaction.
observations.observed_result: Default variant: Color=Black, Size=12″x18″. Personalize template field (artwork id 4081): no default selection (null) — the required '*' template field starts empty.

observations.action: Select variant Color=White, Size=24″x36″ via the visible swatch/radio labels.
observations.observed_result: Selection succeeded (radio state + visual highlight updated). Displayed price changed from $55.99 USD (Black/12x18 default) to $89.99 USD (White/24x36). Recording the price DISPLAY only; not inferring the underlying per-variant pricing/markup rule from 2 data points.

observations.action: Select personalize template option "2" (artwork field 4081, value template-578330, 'Poster - Woman and dog clipart template').
observations.observed_result: Selecting the template revealed a full new set of required fields not previously visible: Choose Woman's Skin Tone*, Choose Woman's Hairstyle*, Woman Name*, Choose Cat Breed #1*, Cat Name #1*, Choose Cat Breed #2*, Cat Name #2*. This is a template -> dependent-field-set dependency. 'Skin Tone' auto-defaulted to one of its 3 values on template selection; Hairstyle/Name/Cat fields did not auto-default. Selecting template option "1" (template-277843) instead reveals a SIMILAR but smaller set (only 1 cat breed+name pair); template "3" (template-156669) reveals 3 cat breed+name pairs — confirming the dependent field COUNT itself varies by which template value is chosen.
observations.state_before: Template field empty; only the 3 template thumbnail options + Color/Size visible in the personalize panel.

observations.action: Select a Cat Breed group option (e.g. value 5988 'British fold') for 'Choose Cat Breed #1'.
observations.observed_result: Selecting the breed group revealed a SECOND, NESTED required radiogroup (name="layer-<field>-children", e.g. layer-678434-children) of 10 specific colored/patterned clipart image variants for that breed — none pre-selected. The visually-collapsed initial UI (breed pill + a small representative thumbnail) does not make this nested requirement obvious; it only appears in the DOM/UI after a breed is chosen. This is a SECOND LEVEL of option dependency (template -> breed field -> breed-specific clipart variant), distinct from and deeper than the template->fields dependency at SF-OBS-005. The same pattern applies independently to 'Choose Cat Breed #2' (nested group name layer-426671-children).

evidence_refs.note: SF-OBS-009 step records breed1ChildValue/breed2ChildValue confirming the nested selection was made.

observations.action: Click ADD TO CART while Hairstyle / Woman Name / Cat Breed#1 (+child) / Cat Name#1 / Cat Breed#2 (+child) / Cat Name#2 are still empty (only template + auto-defaulted skin tone set).
observations.observed_result: Client-side validation correctly blocked submission: per-field inline errors appeared ("Choose Woman's Hairstyle* This field is required!", "Woman Name* This field is required!", "Choose Cat Breed #1* This field is required!", "Cat Name #1* This field is required!", "Choose Cat Breed #2* This field is required!", "Cat Name #2* This field is required!") plus a generic "Error: Some fields are required or invalid data" summary. Cart item_count remained 0 (confirmed via in-page fetch('/cart.js') later in the session, since the direct API-context GET hit a transient Shopify rate-limit interstitial at this exact step).
observations.state_after: Cart still empty (item_count 0); validation errors displayed.

observations.action: Fill every discoverable required field: Hairstyle=Black, Woman Name='Mia', Cat Breed #1=British fold + first nested clipart variant, Cat Name #1='Milo', Cat Breed #2=Long hair + first nested clipart variant, Cat Name #2='Coco'. Verified via DOM that all corresponding radio inputs report checked=true and text inputs hold the typed values, and that the (hidden) 'confirmed' responsibility checkbox reports checked=true.
observations.observed_result: All PER-FIELD inline 'This field is required!' messages disappeared after filling. However, a generic 'Error: Some fields are required or invalid data' banner (class tee-error / tee-error__message) STILL appears immediately upon clicking ADD TO CART, and clicking ADD TO CART produced ZERO network requests to any cart or teeinblue endpoint (verified with a request listener spanning the click). Retried with: (a) re-selecting via .check({force:true}) on the underlying radio inputs, and (b) manually dispatching input/change/click DOM events on the already-checked radio elements — the generic error persisted in both retries. Reproduced this exact pattern with template option "1" as well (single-cat, fewer total fields), ruling out a mistake specific to template 2's extra cat-breed-#2 selection.
observations.state_before: All fields empty except template + auto-defaulted skin tone; cart empty.
observations.state_after: All fields visibly filled/selected with no per-field errors; cart STILL empty (item_count 0); generic top-level error banner present; 0 network requests fired on ADD TO CART click.

evidence_refs.note: Same failure reproduced with template option 1 (simpler, single-cat field set).
netlog array; no /cart/add.js or teeinblue mutation endpoint entries exist anywhere in this session's captured network log.

observations.action: Click the 'Preview' button (tee-btn--preview), both before and after filling personalization fields.

The image shown was IDENTICAL in both checks (before any personalize selection, and after template+skin-tone+hairstyle+names+cat-breeds were all filled) — no live/dynamic recomposition of the entered personalization values (names, hairstyle, skin tone, cat breed/variant) was observed in this preview surface within this session.
observations.state_after: All personalization fields filled; preview modal content unchanged from the 'before' state.

observations.action: Set quantity to 2 via the teeinblue quantity stepper (input.tee-quantity-input), distinct from the theme's own native (hidden) Shopify quantity input on the same form.
observations.observed_result: Quantity field accepted value 2. Two separate 'quantity' inputs exist in the DOM for this product form: the teeinblue widget's own visible stepper and the theme's native (non-interactive/hidden for this campaign) Shopify quantity input — only the teeinblue one is user-facing.

observations.action: Attempt to reach the cart drawer/page after a 'fully filled' ADD TO CART click.
observations.observed_result: No cart-drawer DOM element appeared (queried cart-drawer, #CartDrawer, [class*=cart-drawer], .drawer — none found/populated). Navigating to /cart afterwards showed 'Your cart is empty'. Consistent with SF-OBS-008: the ATC submission never reached the server, so no cart mutation occurred and there is nothing for the drawer/page to display.

observations.action: Cleanup: POST /cart/clear.js at end of session (defensive, cart was already empty since ATC never succeeded).
observations.observed_result: cart/clear.js call itself returned a transient HTTP 429 Shopify rate-limit interstitial (repeated automated requests in this session triggered Cloudflare's 'Verifying your connection...' page); a subsequent plain `curl` from outside the Playwright session, several minutes later, confirmed the store's normal 302 redirect behavior had resumed (i.e. not a persistent block). Since the cart never held an item in this session (confirmed at every earlier checkpoint, e.g. SF-OBS-007/008/011), no real cleanup was structurally necessary.

cart_handoff_observations.detail: Add-to-cart could not be completed. Generic client-side validation error ('Error: Some fields are required or invalid data') persists and blocks submission (0 network requests fired) even after every visible required field is filled/selected with no remaining per-field error text. Reproduced across 2 distinct template configurations (1-cat and 2-cat). Cart drawer, cart page line items, personalization line-item properties, and quantity-update-in-cart were consequently NOT verifiable in this session.
cart_handoff_observations.recommended_followup: Needs either (a) a real, non-headless manual browser session to rule out an automation-specific interaction quirk, or (b) code-config-explorer / api-explorer review of the teeinblue SDK v1 client-side validation logic to identify which internal condition remains falsy despite the visible field states.

cart_handoff_observations.automation_artifact_hypothesis: It is plausible that this automation session's interaction technique (label .click() combined with .check({force:true}) and manually-dispatched input/change/click events, rather than a real pointer click + real keyboard typing) failed to fully set ONE field somewhere in the 2-level dependency chain in the exact way the widget's internal (likely framework-level, e.g. Vue/React) validation state expects — for example, the nested breed-specific clipart-variant 'children' field appearing correctly checked in the raw DOM but not correctly registered in the app's internal reactive state — causing the widget to report the form as incomplete even though a DOM read shows all fields populated. This would explain how side A (automated: blocked) and side B (user manual, 2 attempts including a deliberate recheck: works) could both be factually accurate without either being wrong. This hypothesis is offered as INFERRED reasoning only — it is NOT elevated to CONFIRMED_EXPECTED, because: (1) the user's manual-test report has no accompanying evidence file (screenshot/network capture) in this run, and (2) this agent has not re-run the flow with real, slow, step-by-step click/type interaction to obtain first-party evidence consistent with the user's report. Until such evidence exists, SF-OBS-007/008/011 stand as the only evidence-backed record of this session and are not overwritten.
